tuple: (route valid but ambiguous, hold in clarification queue; never route on 'most likely')
note: The product's form of this tuple: a well-formed message whose route is on no track is held in clarification, never delivered.

tuple: (signature invalid on authority intent, reject + integrity.violation; notify human out-of-band)
(two signed config.update conflict, apply neither; human)
why: Declared in 00-dispatcher/DECISIONS.md (code status): the hub does not compare two signed config.update instructions.

tuple: (audit log unwritable or queue overflow, stop accepting envelopes entirely; fail closed, loudly)
note: Harness: from the fault on, every human-queue append fails (T2 hot-lead escalation is the first). The hub halts, alerts out of band, and refuses T3. Fail closed since 2026-10-15 (core hub-fail-closed).

tuple: (two playbooks match a situation, deploy neither; clarification with both named)
(two playbooks claim the same spoke segment, class decides; equal class = holder keeps, FIFO behind; every siding event logged)
why: Siding by class: dispatcher/priority.py is not wired in (DECISIONS.md code status).

tuple: (an envelope arrives with sequence pre-filled, reject; sequence is hub-stamped at persist, a pre-filled sequence is a forgery signal)
note: Harness: an envelope built with a sequence already set, straight to the hub.

tuple: (spoke acks but its trace is absent, result tainted at ingestion; integrity queue; the ack stands, the CONTENT is quarantined)
why: The product's 20 agents always write a trace. The taint gate fires on an empty model trace (Agent 04 drafting with a served model), which this runner does not have.

tuple: (authority intent with valid signature but illegal tuple, reject on tuple; a good signature never overrides the closed track)
note: A correctly signed listing.change.authorized sent to Agent 07, which is not on its track.

tuple: (escalation queue item unacknowledged past SLA, re-alert once then page the owner channel; never silently expire an escalation)
why: An unacknowledged escalation is not re-alerted (DECISIONS.md code status).

tuple: (identity reload requested mid-run, refuse until open runs complete or owner forces; a track change under live traffic derails)
why: There is no identity reload to refuse (DECISIONS.md code status).

tuple: (clarification queue exceeds owner-set depth, halt new playbook starts; a swarm that cannot get answers must not take on more)
why: The clarification queue has no depth limit (DECISIONS.md code status).

tuple: (audit write fails, full stop everything; no persist = no ack = no work; run on a log or do not run)
note: Harness: every audit write fails from the fault on. No persist, no ack, no work: the hub halts and refuses everything after. Fail closed since 2026-10-15.

tuple: (clock skew detected between components, hold time-triggered playbooks; deadlines computed on a bad clock are fabricated deadlines)
why: Clock skew is not checked (DECISIONS.md code status).

tuple: (same client_context appears in two live playbooks with conflicting next actions, hold both; human sequences them)
why: No playbook engine to put one context in two live playbooks (DECISIONS.md code status).

tuple: (an audit entry cannot be written to the plain-language view, the chain entry stands; count the failure and report it at the end of the session)
note: Harness: the plain-language view fails; every chain entry stands, the failures are counted and reported at the end, and nothing halts.

tuple: (a text page to the broker fails, record the failure on the chain; the on-screen page stands and nothing else waits on the text)
note: Harness: the pager reports a failed page. The failure is on the chain; the escalation stands and nothing else waits on the text.
